For just €10, we will take care of all your laundry</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Do you offer options for guests with dietary restrictions?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Yes, we can accommodate vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and lactose-free diets. Please let us know in advance so our kitchen can cater to your needs.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Is breakfast included in the room rate?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Yes, breakfast is included in all rates and is served buffet-style from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Do you offer airport transfer services?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Yes, we can arrange a transfer upon request. Contact us to book your ride at welcome@floripa.it</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What is the nearest airport?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">The closest airports are Catania (about 1.5 hours by car) and Comiso (about 1 hour by car).</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">How can I pay during my stay?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">We accept cash, Visa, and MasterCard (American Express not accepted).</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What is your cancellation policy?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">We offer different flexible options. We recommend checking our booking page or contacting us for more details.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Are there medical centers or hospitals near Floripa?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">There is a small medical center in Pozzallo (6 km from Floripa). We also have basic medical supplies at reception. The nearest hospital is in Modica, about 35 minutes away.
</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Is wifi available?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Yes, Wifi is free and available throughout the property. We apologize if the connection is sometimes unstable - our area is still quite rural, and occasional Wi-Fi drops can happen. </p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What types of accommodation do you offer?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">We have private rooms, bungalows, and dorms, all carefully furnished to ensure comfort and relaxation in a Balinese-inspired style. All accommodations overlook our beautiful garden, where the vibrant colors of our flowers will amaze you.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What&#x27;s the minimum stay?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">To create a community feeling where everyone has time to get to know each other, the minimum booking length is 3 nights. In August, the minimum booking length is 7 nights in a private room and 4 nights in a shared room.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Do I have to pre-book add-ons?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">No, you do not need to pre-book any add ons. You can do it once on site. But if you prefer having everything set before-hand, feel free to send us an email at welcome@floripa.it.</p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">Can I add extras on arrival?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">Absolutely—visit reception any time and we&#x27;ll be happy to set you up with additional activities. </p></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="w-dyn-item"><div class="faq3_accordion"><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d40" class="faq3_question"><div class="text-size-medium text-weight-bold">What’s included in the Basic Package?</div><div class="faq3_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small w-embed"><svg></svg></div></div></div><div data-w-id="c3a44d14-17f5-f989-b164-f2ad3ede7d44" class="faq3_answer"><div class="margin-bottom margin-small text-align-left"><p class="text-size-regular">The room (solo or shared) + two yoga classes a day + daily breakfast + chair and umbrella at Zuma Beach</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><div class="cta-section-light wellness-banner wellness-2"><div class="container new-image"><div
